event_data.context:
This was found during final review of 20260811-9xam. The runner correctly fails closed and records the invalid value; only the human-readable dashboard label is misleading.

Implementation notes
The failure path spans scripts/evals/run.sh status output and scripts/evals/build-site.mjs rendering. Use one normalization/presentation contract for natural, forced, and invalid or unavailable provenance.
event_data.summary: When an evaluation run is rejected because its invocation mode is invalid, the dashboard currently labels that run as natural contextual routing. Preserve the invalid value in diagnostic artifacts, but present it as invalid or unavailable in the dashboard so maintainers do not mistake a rejected run for canonical natural-routing evidence.
event_data.title: Show invalid evaluation modes accurately in the dashboard
